Data stored on your device
Bluetooth device names and addresses, saved audio configurations, app preferences and restore session progress are stored locally. Diagnostics contain device and app information, connection events and operation results.

How data is used
This information is used to read audio settings, save and restore configurations, show status notifications and diagnose problems. No account is required to use the app.

Sharing
The app has no advertising or analytics services and does not automatically upload these records. Copied logs are placed on the system clipboard. Clipboard history and syncing follow your system settings. You choose where to share them. Project links open in your browser; visits to GitHub follow its privacy policy.

Permissions
Nearby devices access is used to read Bluetooth state. Notifications and battery settings support background status and restore. Shizuku API provides an optional way to authorize device association.

Retention and deletion
Saved configurations are kept until you delete them. Diagnostics use a rolling log. You can delete configurations in Library and clear logs in Activity log. Clearing app data or uninstalling removes app-local records. Bluetooth pairings and system-managed device associations are managed in Android settings.
